SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA

07:00 P.M.
TELECONFERENCE MEETING AUTHORIZED BY STATE OF CALIFORNIA EXECUTIVE ORDERS N-25-20 AND N-29-20 VIA ZOOM VIDEO COMMUNICATIONS, MEETING ID #868 5881 3831
*COVID-19 NOTICE*
To protect public health and safety during the local, state, and federally declared COVID-19 emergency, the City Council Chamber and City Hall are closed to the public. Consistent with State of California Executive Orders N-25-20 and N-29-20 and the Los Angeles County Health Officer’s “Safer at Home Order for Control of COVID-19” the City Council will participate in the meeting through teleconference. Public participation in the meeting will be facilitated through the electronic methods as described below.
Agenda Materials:
The agenda and agenda packet related to items on this agenda are available for public inspection at www.cerritos.us. Materials submitted to the City Council/Successor Agency after distribution of the agenda packet will be made available for public inspection at www.cerritos.us.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION:
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at www.cerritos.us and on Cerritos TV3.
Public Comments:
Members of the public may provide public comment through the following methods:
Email: Members of the public may provide public comment by submitting an email to city_clerk@cerritos.us by 5:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the meeting date and agenda item number for which you would like to provide comment in the subject line of the email. The public comment will be distributed to all members of the City Council. During the meeting your name and summary comments will be read into the record. The document will be retained with the public record of the meeting.
Teleconference Participation: You may provide audio public comment by connecting to the teleconference meeting online or by telephone/mobile call (please select only one method). Public speakers will be queued to provide comment at the appropriate time on the agenda. You must be available to provide comment at the time your connection is “unmuted.” If you are not planning on providing public comment we encourage you to observe the meeting via livestream or on Cerritos TV3 to allow staff to more effectively manage the number of teleconference connections.
Cerritos Zoom meeting online link: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/86858813831
Cerritos Zoom Meeting call-in telephone number: (669) 900-6833
Cerritos Zoom Meeting ID: 868 5881 3831
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations:
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the Office of the City Clerk/Treasurer at (562) 916-1248 to request accommodation. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the teleconference meeting.

MINUTES OF A SPECIAL MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL AND THE
SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY HELD ON

1.  Call to Order

  Mayor Solanki called the meeting to order at 7:00 p.m.

  Mayor Solanki announced the Sunday, May 10, 2020 passing of City
  Councilmember and former Mayor Jim Edwards. A tribute to his life and service to
  the City of Cerritos was given.

  Councilmember Jim Edwards was elected to the Cerritos City Council in 2005, was
  re-elected in 2009, and served as Mayor of Cerritos from 2008 to 2009 and 2012
  to 2013. He was re-elected to the City Council again in 2015 and in 2020.

  He was a Cerritos resident for more than 43 years, served as a Cerritos Parks and
  Recreation Commissioner, and as a Cerritos Community Safety Committee
  member. He served on the Board of Directors of the Friends of Arts Education at
  the Cerritos Center for the Performing Arts in 2013 and 2014, including a term as
  president.

  Councilmember Edwards was active in the Cerritos Optimist Club, the Vietnam
  Veterans Association, Friends of the 1st Combat Engineer Battalion Adoption
  Committee, and volunteer photographer for the Los Angeles County Fire
  Department.

  He served on the Board of Directors for Fisher House of Southern California at the
  Long Beach VA Hospital, as a Board member and President for two years on the
  Pathways Volunteer Hospice Board. His community involvement also included
  serving on the boards of the Los Cerritos YMCA, Community Family Guidance
  Center and the Cerritos Regional Chamber of Commerce. He also served as
  President of the County of Los Angeles Cerritos Regional County Park Authority
  from 2000 to 2002 and served on the Board of Directors of the American Heart
  Association from 1998 to 2001.

  Councilmember Edwards was honored with the Spirit of Service Award from the
  Human Services Association in 2010 and the Protector of Children Award from
  Community Family Guidance Center in 2018.

  He retired from a career as a teacher and administrator in the ABC Unified School
  District. He served 30 years at Richard Gahr High School, four years at Whitney
  Community Learning Center, at Cerritos College as a part-time instructor and for
  10 years as the Director of Cerritos College Summer Sports Camp.

  He had nearly three decades of experience in athletics, coaching various varsity
  sports, including baseball, cross country, soccer, softball, and track and field. He
  served as the Director of Athletics at Gahr High School and meet manager for the
  San Gabriel Valley League in cross country and track and field.

  He served in the United States Army, including a year in Vietnam during the
  Vietnam War.

  Members of the community were welcomed to place memorial tributes to
  Councilmember Edwards at the City of Cerritos Veterans Memorial located in the
  Cerritos Civic Center.
 City of Cerritos  May 11, 2020
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 2 of 4

  Those who wished to make a contribution in memory of Councilmember Edwards
  were informed of the non-profit organizations that he supported and served,
  including Fisher House, Pathways Volunteer Hospice and Community Family
  Guidance Center.

  The City of Cerritos extended its heartfelt condolences to Councilmember Jim
  Edwards’ wife, Connie, and their children, grandchildren, and great-grandson.

  Councilmember Hu shared her thoughts and memories of Councilmember Jim
  Edwards and extended condolences to his family.

  Mayor Pro-Tem Vo shared his thoughts and memories of Councilmember Jim
  Edwards and extended condolences to his family.

  A video presentation was displayed in honor of the service of former Mayor and
  City Councilmember Jim Edwards.

Please refer to the adjournment section of these minutes for information
regarding the business items listed below. None of these items were considered
on May 11, 2020 and all items were continued to May 18, 2020.
